text: The Budget Subcommittee for City Hall and North York Civic Centre Consultation will hear public presentations on the 2019 Capital, Operating and Rate Supported Budgets at City Hall on February 7, 2019 from 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. At its meeting on January 28, 2019, the Budget Committee established two subcommittees to hear the public deputations on the 2019 Capital, Operating and Rate Supported Budgets at City Hall, North York Civic Centre, Scarborough Civic Centre and Etobicoke Civic Centre, and made appointments to the Subcommittees as follows: 2019 Budget Public Deputation Meetings Name of Subcommittee Members Meeting Dates, Locations and Times Budget Subcommittee for City Hall and North York Civic Centre Consultation Councillor Crawford (Chair) Councillor Carroll Councillor Layton February 7, 2019 City Hall 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; and 6:00 p.m. onwards February 11, 2019 North York…
